Subject: Staff Ops Sync — Wins, Risks, & Immediate Asks (QBR prep)

Team — pulling together a short weekly snapshot ahead of next week's QBR. Below are the things I care about for the executive roll-up and any asks that need leadership action. Reply inline if you have updates I should fold into the deck.

Wins
- Atlas pilot: Week 3 latency improved by 18% after KV-cache tuning; Anna confirmed test traffic matched production patterns.
- Dedicated infra: we completed node replacement with zero downtime for the EU pool (thanks to Ops).
- Optimize: new quantization profile pilot reduced token cost ~9% on routing-heavy flows.

Risks / Current Blockers
- Atlas security questionnaire: procurement needs SOC 2 evidence and clarified data retention policy by Fri (see attachment). If we don't get docs to them, procurement will push the contract timeline.
- Support capacity: two senior SREs on parental leave next week. This reduces our escalation bandwidth for late-evening incidents. Ops will reroute pager; we may need to shift on-call for the week.
- Dedicated forecasting: capacity burn in April could exceed commit if usage on the new model variant continues to spike. Finance wants a decision on burst policy by Monday.

Immediate Asks (what I need from leaders)
1) Laura: Can you OK a one-week temporary contractor to cover one SRE on-call slot (budget up to $12k) so we don't take on-call fatigue risk? Need confirmation by EOD tomorrow.
2) Markus: Please review and approve the proposed burst-cap policy (sheet attached) or suggest alternatives. Decision required by Mon so we can confirm commit sizing.
3) Maya / Jonas: I need a one-slide summary of customer-impact metrics (latency, error-rate, biz-implication) for Atlas pilot to include in the QBR deck — due Fri noon.

Attachments: QBR_prep_one-pager.pdf, Atlas_MutualActionPlan.xlsx
Drive: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1QBRprep_example

Thanks — short and focused here. I will push a consolidated deck draft by Thu 5pm PT.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success & GTM Ops
